shots.analysis: Symmetrical wide of the golden hall: long white-jade aisle flanked by rows of disciples, dais with Saintess and Archbishop far away, incense smoke, sunbeams. Hundreds of tiny figures can shimmer, so keep every motion slow and subject motion minimal.

shots.prompt: Premium painterly donghua animation, keeping the exact art style, lighting and character designs of the first frame. A vast golden palace hall during a solemn ceremony: rows of disciples stand motionless in neat lines on both sides of the long white jade aisle, the white silk banners sway very slightly, wisps of white incense smoke drift slowly across the floor and golden sunbeams shimmer with floating dust, while at the far end the Saintess and the Archbishop stand still on the dais. The camera glides slowly and smoothly forward and downward along the center of the aisle in one steady, majestic crane move, keeping the dais centered. The sound is a deep, low ceremonial horn drone, soft distant chanting and a single slow temple bell.
